how.title: How ClaimSathi works
sections: 1. Upload your insurer's letter
Upload the rejection or settlement letter as a PDF. We read the text on it.
2. Check what we read
We show the details and deductions we found. You fix anything wrong and confirm. We only use details you confirm.
3. See the findings
We check each deduction and reason against fixed rules. Every rule we quote is checked word for word against its source, and you can open the source.
4. Get your letter
We write a letter to the insurer's grievance officer from your confirmed details. You read it, edit it if you like, and send it yourself.
5. Track deadlines
Log when you send it. We work out when you can go to the Insurance Ombudsman and the last day to do it, and remind you.

dont.title: What we don't do
sections: We are not lawyers
ClaimSathi is a self-help drafting tool, not legal advice.
We don't send anything for you
You send every letter and complaint yourself.
We don't charge you
ClaimSathi is free. We take no success fee.
We don't promise results
We can't say whether your insurer will pay. We show which rules apply and where they come from.
We don't handle other insurance
Only health insurance claims in India for now.

free.title: Free official channels
free.intro: All three are free. You don't need anyone's help to use them.
free.warning: Never pay anyone claiming to be the Ombudsman, or offering to file for a fee.
insurer: Write here first. Every insurer has a grievance redressal officer. ClaimSathi writes this letter for you.
bima: IRDAI's complaint portal. Optional, and it can run alongside your other steps. Toll-free: 155255 or 1800 4254 732.
ombudsman: If the insurer rejects your grievance, or doesn't reply within a month, you can complain to the Ombudsman within a year.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.empty: We haven't published an audit yet. We will publish one before we open to everyone.
accuracy.method: How we check: every quote we show is matched word for word against its source text before you see it. Quotes that don't match are removed, never shown.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
sections: What we collect
Your email address, the documents you upload, the details we read from them, and what you type in.
Why
To explain your claim decision, write your letters and remind you of deadlines. Nothing else.
Where it is kept
In India. Names, emails and policy numbers are encrypted.
How long
Uploaded files are deleted 90 days after you close a case (you can extend once). You can download or delete everything at any time in Settings.
Your rights
You can see, download, correct and delete your data, and withdraw consent, from Settings.

terms.title: Terms of use
sections: The service
ClaimSathi helps you understand a health insurance claim decision and draft letters. It is free.
Your responsibility
You check every letter before sending it and you send it yourself. Only use documents you are allowed to share.
No legal advice
Nothing here is legal advice. For legal advice, talk to a lawyer.
Fair use
Don't misuse the service or try to access other people's cases.
